modules.label: Tellplatz Scenario
modules.title: Tellplatz scenario

modules.boundary: A screening signal is not a site recommendation.

modules.label: Learn
modules.title: Sponge-city explainers
modules.purpose: Understand the measures, mechanisms and language behind a sponge city.
modules.boundary: Educational context does not establish local performance.

modules.label: Street X-Ray
modules.title: Street X-Ray
modules.purpose: Expose hypotheses, blockers, gatekeepers and missing evidence.
modules.boundary: Visible space is not automatically buildable space.

modules.label: Rain Walk
modules.title: Rain Walk
modules.purpose: Turn local observation into a provenance-bearing field note.
modules.boundary: Surface observation cannot reveal underground conditions.

modules.label: Data Charter
modules.title: Data Charter
modules.purpose: Mark what is known, derived, assumed, modelled, restricted or missing.
modules.boundary: A relevant dataset is not automatically valid for a decision.

modules.label: Connected Case
modules.title: Connected Case
modules.purpose: Connect claims, gaps, gatekeepers and actions into one bounded case.
modules.boundary: The current state is investigation, not a recommendation to construct.

modules.label: Site Scoping Map
modules.title: Basel Site Scoping
modules.purpose: Compare candidate places and inspect the dataset catalogue.
modules.boundary: Candidate locations and scores are illustrative screening fixtures.

modules.label: Street Lab
modules.title: Street Lab
modules.purpose: Explore how a synthetic street routes rain through connected interventions.
modules.boundary: Illustrative water model, not validated engineering performance.

modules.label: Evidence Atlas
modules.title: Evidence Atlas + Situation Map
modules.purpose: Inspect claims, sources, actors and spatial context.
modules.boundary: Context does not establish site feasibility.

modules.label: Charter Map
modules.title: Data Charter Map
modules.purpose: Explore decision indicators, evidence classes and gatekeepers.
modules.boundary: Unknown evidence cannot become a favourable default.

modules.label: Catalogue
modules.title: Sponge Catalogue
modules.purpose: Inspect mechanisms, prerequisites and Basel precedents.
modules.boundary: Candidate measures are not site-specific design recipes.

modules.label: Decision Pathway
modules.title: Decision Pathway
modules.purpose: Explore who can decide, what evidence is needed and what comes next.
modules.boundary: An investigation package is not construction approval.
